snippet.title: Paper Mario: Mystical Mission - F3 Trailer | NicTube
snippet.description:
Welcome to my newest little PM64 mod (around 1 hour long), Mystical Mission! 

★ Release Date: NOW! ★
Feel free to join the Star Nova Discord server to download and discuss the mod :)
Discord: https://discord.gg/mpR2tjhmTU


First of all, don't worry about progress regarding Star Nova - it's still in development. In fact, Mystical Mission is once again connected to Star Nova's story in quite a few ways!
(This one was originally made for the Water Jam Contest on the Star Haven Discord.)

Join Mario as he investigates a truly mysterious, strange island, searching for the cause of the Fatal Flood, which submerged the entire Mushroom Kingdom.

New maps, new story, new enemy attacks - as well as a "new" partner!

There is 7 optional Shine Pieces to collect in the entire mod, for everyone who enjoys exploring and collecting.

Hope you enjoy! :)
